q: Oseledec's Multiplicative Ergodic Theorem extends Lyapunov exponents to ergodic systems by stating:
opts: For a.e. initial condition, the Lyapunov exponents exist and are constant (ergodic averages)
Lyapunov exponents are always zero for ergodic systems
The exponents depend continuously on the initial condition
exp: Oseledec (1968): for a cocycle over an ergodic MPT, the Lyapunov exponents λ₁≥λ₂≥… exist for a.e. x, are constant (independent of x), and define the Lyapunov spectrum. This is the multiplicative analogue of Birkhoff's theorem.
